days.title: Archaeology and Ridge Heights
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hondsrug
stops.detail: The national park lies partly on the approximately 25-meter-high Hondsrug ridge, which stretches from the Drentsche Plateau to the Hogeland on the coast.

stops.name: De Strubben-Kniphorstbosch
stops.detail: In addition to nature areas worthy of protection such as heathlands, grasslands, small wooded areas and sand drifts, the park also includes the first archaeological reserve in the Netherlands with De Strubben-Kniphorstbosch.

days.title: Heathland History and Defense Lines
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Balloërveld
stops.detail: Also part of the park area is the former military training area Balloërveld.

stops.name: Frieslandriegel
stops.detail: During the Second World War, this place belonged to the so-called "Frieslandriegel", a defense line of the German Wehrmacht against the Allied forces advancing from the west.
